tickets.title: Automated B2B Treasury Outbound Sprint & Safe App Integration for Top-10 Base DAOs
tickets.user_story: As a Web3 DAO/startup CFO, I want a 1-click Safe App and pre-calculated Treasury Shield voucher so that I can eliminate my team's $500+/mo SaaS liabilities using idle stablecoins without sacrificing self-custody.
tickets.context_and_signals: Pipeline receipt rec_pipe_b2b_leads_top10 staged 10 Tier-1 leads (AerodromeFi, Virtuals, Morpho Labs, Moonwell, Talent Protocol) with $18.5M addressable treasury and $5.3k/mo burn. Leads need automated multi-channel dispatch (Warpcast, TG, Email, LinkedIn) and Safe Multisig execution manifests.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Automated dispatch script packages and sends personalized multi-channel copy for all 10 staged B2B leads without formatting errors or placeholders.
2. Safe App manifest `safe-manifest.json` conforms to Safe {Core} standard, allowing 1-click loading inside app.safe.global on Base.
3. Each outbound packet includes a cryptographically verifiable financial proof link confirming 100% principal retention and zero bank out-of-pocket spend.
4. Lead engagement and voucher clicks are logged to `defi_garden/state/pipeline_receipts.jsonl` with UTM parameters.
definition_of_done: File `defi_garden/public/safe-manifest.json` committed and validated against Safe App JSON schema.

tickets.title: CFO & DAO Ops Interactive Proof-of-Yield Calculator & 1-Click Voucher Simulator
tickets.user_story: As a prospective B2B treasury buyer, I want an interactive, real-time ROI and escrow simulator on plan.html so that I can visualize 5-year SaaS cashflow savings under variable Base lending APYs.
tickets.context_and_signals: Initial feedback from treasury leads indicates confusion around the 1.25x over-collateralization buffer vs headline APY. Clear visual sliders showing the 3-month Surplus Sponge and principal invariant resolve this objection.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Planner UI parses `preset=treasury_shield` and query params (`company`, `bill`, `capital`, `stack`) to hydrate branded dashboard.
2. Tabular numerals render 1-year, 3-year, and 5-year cumulative cash savings compared to traditional fiat bank burn.
3. Displays live Base Aave V3/Morpho Blue blend rate with explicit 1.25x safety buffer disclosure.
4. Responsive across desktop and mobile down to 360px without horizontal overflow.
definition_of_done: Zero neumorphic CSS rules; 100% compliance with Quiet Design System (`--ui-*` tokens).
Automated end-to-end Cypress/Playwright assertion verifying URL hydration.

4. All tests in `tests/test_card_baas_adapter.py` pass with zero regressions.

tickets.title: Dual-Oracle Divergence Tripwire & Chainlink/Pyth Spread Real-Time Risk Monitor
tickets.user_story: As a risk engineer and protocol auditor, I want a dual-oracle divergence monitor (Chainlink primary + Pyth/Redstone secondary) so that keepers freeze rebalancing and yield sweeps if prices diverge by >15 bps or stale >3600s.
tickets.context_and_signals: Risk telemetry rec_risk_telemetry_001 recorded a safe 2.1 bps dual-oracle spread on Base (8453). However, extreme volatility could cause depeg or oracle lag. The keeper engine must enforce the 15 bps tripwire before executing batch sweeps.
acceptance_criteria: 1. `KeeperEngine.check_oracle_spread()` computes absolute spread between primary (Chainlink) and secondary (Pyth/Redstone) feeds.
2. If `spread_bps > 15.0`, sweep execution is aborted with reason `Oracle divergence tripwire` and flagged as `FREEZE_REBALANCE_AND_HARVEST`.
3. If oracle price staleness exceeds 3600 seconds, sweep is blocked with `Oracle stale` warning.
4. Telemetry receipt is appended to `defi_garden/state/risk_telemetry_receipts.jsonl` on every check.
definition_of_done: Unit test in `defi_garden/tests/test_keeper_batch_engine.py` asserting oracle tripwire abort behavior.
Receipt generated and validated with zero schema errors.

tickets.title: Dynamic Surplus Sponge Reserve Auto-Balancing & Floating APY Decay Haircut Engine
tickets.user_story: As a depositor, I want my vault to automatically accumulate excess bull-market yield into a 3-month Surplus Sponge buffer so that temporary rate drops never cause my subscription card to decline.
tickets.context_and_signals: Risk telemetry shows Surplus Sponge accumulating (2.2 months runway on mainnet). Solvency formulas enforce 1.25x over-collateralization and 1-month initial liquid escrow. The engine must simulate 12-month decay curves and test the Bounded Grace Tap.
acceptance_criteria: 1. `V2SolvencyEngine.simulate_monthly_settlement()` routes yield > monthly bill into escrow until reaching 3-month cap.
2. When escrow is full (3 months), excess yield is tagged as `surplus_distributable_usd`.
3. When yield is below bill liability, deficit is drawn from escrow without touching principal ($\Delta P \equiv 0$).
4. If escrow is exhausted, triggers a bounded 1-month grace tap while firing a critical top-up webhook.
definition_of_done: Comprehensive test cases in `defi_garden/tests/test_v2_solvency_engine.py` covering surplus accumulation, escrow drain, and grace tap.

tickets.title: EURC/USDC Cross-Currency Slippage Armor & Dynamic VAT/Tax Headroom Model
tickets.user_story: As an EU or international subscriber, I want dynamic +20% VAT/tax headroom and FX spread protection on EURC/USDC vault pairs so that foreign exchange fluctuation never causes payment rejections.
tickets.context_and_signals: Auto Finance Base EUR vault telemetry showed 3.4 bps EUR/USD divergence. Subscriptions in Europe (Spotify EUR, ChatGPT with EU VAT) require +20% headroom to prevent card processor declines on billing day.
acceptance_criteria: 1. `calculate_required_collateral()` multiplies raw monthly bill by 1.20 tax/VAT headroom before capital requirement calculation.
2. FX slippage armor verifies exchange rate spread between EURC and USDC is under 50 bps before executing cross-currency sweep.
3. If EUR/USD spread exceeds 50 bps, keeper holds settlement until spread narrows or routes through native EURC proxy.
4. Emits structured log with exact gross liability and net settled fiat amount.
definition_of_done: FX and VAT headroom assertions added to `defi_garden/tests/test_v2_solvency_engine.py`.

tickets.title: Multi-Vault 1st-of-Month Automated Batch Yield Sweeper & Superchain Paymaster Gas Sponsorship
tickets.user_story: As the keeper network operator, I want an autonomous batch execution script running on Base with Paymaster gas sponsorship so that dozens of vault yield sweeps are batched into a single low-cost transaction (<$0.02) on the 1st of every month.
tickets.context_and_signals: Execution receipts rcpt_1a03a98fb65 and rcpt_1a03aa5e022 verified 2-vault batch sweeps on Base with $0.0132 gas cost and $45 protocol fees collected. Scaling to 100+ vaults requires automated multicall batching and Paymaster sponsorship.
acceptance_criteria: 1. `KeeperEngine.execute_batch_sweep()` aggregates all eligible intent vaults into a single atomic Multicall3 execution.
2. Enforces gas ceiling check (blocks execution if Base gas > 15 Gwei).
3. Computes 20% protocol performance fee and transfers net yield to user card deposit proxies.
4. Generates immutable cryptographic JSON receipt in `defi_garden/state/keeper_execution_receipts.jsonl`.
definition_of_done: Batch sweep verified via `PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/test_keeper_batch_engine.py`.
Deterministic receipt schema validated with `invariant_principal_protected: true`.
Cron watchdog configured for 1st-of-month 00:05 UTC execution.

tickets.title: Autonomous Keeper Failover Circuit Breaker & Real-Time Telegram Alerting Daemon
tickets.user_story: As an on-call infrastructure engineer, I want automated keeper failover and instant Telegram/webhook alerts if RPC nodes drop or a sweep fails so that zero merchant billings are missed.
tickets.context_and_signals: High-reliability architecture mandates multi-RPC fallback (Base public RPC, Alchemy, QuickNode) and a dead-man watchdog that alerts if 1st-of-month sweeps do not execute within a 2-hour window.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Keeper daemon automatically rotates to secondary RPC upon HTTP 429 or timeout.
2. If sweep fails or is blocked by tripwires, sends structured alert to Telegram with vault ID, reason, and gas price.
3. Watchdog verifies receipt generation within 2 hours of billing window.
4. Circuit breaker halts automated transactions if 2 consecutive RPC calls fail.
definition_of_done: Simulated RPC failure test passes with clean failover.
Alerting dispatch verified in local dry-run.
